note: Global top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New' button, dashboard shortcuts (Issues/MRs/Todos), Help, and user avatar controls
Project sidebar navigation -- renders: fixed section labels (Information, Repository, Issues, Merge requests, Pipelines, etc.); the project name in the context header is user-defined and subtracted
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: project namespace/name and section label (Issues); these are structural identifiers for the current view
Issue list filter tabs -- renders: fixed state labels (Open, Closed, All) with counts
Issue list toolbar -- renders: 'New issue' button, filter/sort dropdowns, and search input controls
Pagination controls -- renders: 'Previous', 'Next', and page size selector
